def DLWContract.ContinuousPair : ℝ → XYT → XYT → Prop :=
fun a f g => cbil a f g = 0 ∧ cdybil a f g - 4 * chx f g = 0
theorem continuous_DLW : ∀ (a : ℝ) (f g : XYT),
  Smooth3 f →
    Smooth3 g →
      Positive3 f → Positive3 g → ContinuousPair a f g → c1 a (cu f g) (cv f g) = 0 ∧ c2 a (cu f g) (cv f g) = 0 :=
fun a f g hf hg hfp hgp hbil => c02_proved a f g hf hg hfp hgp hbil
